items.title: Repair the Apify uk-planning-applications actor flagged under maintenance (failing prefilled-input QA runs)
items.why: Review 2026-W39 (double-down). Apify QA mailed 2026-09-25 (INBOX/ALERTS): faceless-api/uk-planning-applications flagged under maintenance after 3 days of failed prefilled test runs (failed run wuRDmzbT84RthY4CB). The Store is the one shelf with buyers already paying and our only public presence there is now one live actor plus one marked broken; a maintenance flag also weighs on the pending publisher-limit lift. Read the failed run log through the Apify API (APIFY_TOKEN in CI), fix the prefilled input or the actor default, re-push. Evidence 3 × reach 3 ÷ 0.25 days. Built 2026-09-27 (relay read the run log, no token needed): the actor's dataset_schema.json declared `authority` as string while the API serves the planning.data.gov.uk organisation id as a number, so Apify rejected the first pushData of every run (schema-validation-error) — 3 failed runs, 0 succeeded, 2 distinct users had tried it. Fixed the field type and the input (authority is a numeric id, the text 'contains' input would have got a 400), same latent bug in uk-trademark-journal (class_count/series_count integer vs number) fixed, and test/apify-schemas.spec.ts now checks every actor's dataset and input schema against the source's zod schemas so this cannot ship blind again. CI re-pushes both actors; Apify's QA re-runs on the new build.
items.proof: actor no longer flagged; 3 consecutive green QA runs; ≥ 1 paid run within 30 days once public

items.title: Retry a refresh once on a transient D1 error; make the Gazette truncation fail with evidence
items.why: 2026-09-28 Daily numbers: uk-trademark-journal failed on 'D1_ERROR: internal error; reference = …' and uk-charities on 'D1_ERROR: Network connection lost.' — platform faults that each cost a dataset its day although both refresh paths are idempotent. uk-insolvency failed on 'Unexpected end of JSON input' for the third time in a week (09-22, 09-25, 09-28) despite the 3-read retry, and the message says nothing about where the cut is. Built 2026-09-28: store.ts refreshOne retries a source once after 5 s on those D1 messages while the wave is under 6 minutes old (4 tests); the insolvency reader now reads bytes first and reports bytes seen, content-length and the tail after its last attempt, with growing backoff, so the next metrics row carries the evidence to fix it.
items.proof: zero D1-transient refresh errors in the next 14 daily rows; insolvency error text names the cut

items.title: uk-insolvency: retry a momentary Gazette 5xx once (fifth refresh error in eight days)

items.title: Claude Connectors Directory listing: tool annotations, Origin 403, keyless preview, listing pack, CI conformance test
items.why: Exchange 2026-W40 winner (11). The directory lists a remote MCP server to every Claude surface automatically after a policy scan, on the owner's paid plan — the first shelf since Apify with no third-party gate, and its buyers are the owners of the agents that hit our paywall ~80×/day. Today the server fails three portal checks: no readOnlyHint/destructiveHint on any tool (titles exist), no Origin validation on /mcp, and every query tool returns a 200 isError without a key while an authless listing cannot carry one. Build: readOnlyHint true on list_sources/get_usage/query_*/get_changes and readOnlyHint false + destructiveHint false on request_api_key/claim_api_key; Origin middleware (403 on a present, non-allowlisted Origin); keyless preview in the MCP gate (limit ≤ 5 rows, 20 calls/day per client, then the paywall text names the plan and price); docs.html "Use in Claude" section, 64×64 PNG icon, a reviewer test key (free plan, populated); test/mcp-directory.spec.ts asserting title + hint on every tool, names ≤ 64 chars, Origin 403 and a 200 result for every tool without a key. Then one ALERTS owner line: submit at claude.ai/directory/manage (~20 min) with the pack. Sources: claude.com/docs/connectors/building/{submission,review-criteria,managing-your-listing}. Built 2026-09-30 (v0.20.0): annotations on all 22 tools, Origin 403, keyless preview (5 rows, 20 calls/day per client, then the plan text), get_usage answers keyless, docs#claude section, landing card, listing pack docs/CLAUDE-DIRECTORY.md, test/mcp-directory.spec.ts (4 tests), metrics row gains a preview count. Owner: the portal form (ALERTS 2026-09-30).
items.proof: directory usage tab shows ≥ 20 distinct Claude accounts used a tool in the first 30 days and ≥ 1 key issued from a claude.ai referrer; /mcp calls from 160.79.104.0/21 appear in the Daily numbers row

items.title: Lazy OAuth for the MCP server (CIMD + PKCE, magic-link consent, tokens mapped to account keys) so plans bill from Claude, ChatGPT and Cursor
items.why: Exchange 2026-W40 second (8). Claude starts sign-in only on an HTTP 401 with WWW-Authenticate: Bearer resource_metadata=…; a 200 tool error never does, so an authless listing can discover but not convert. Build: /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource and /mcp variant, /.well-known/oauth-authorization-server (code_challenge_methods_supported S256, token_endpoint_auth_methods_supported none, client_id_metadata_document_supported true), /authorize that fetches the CIMD client_id URL, checks redirect_uri exactly (port-agnostic for localhost/127.0.0.1) and renders consent on the magic-link session, /token (form-urlencoded, PKCE, refresh rotation, invalid_grant on stale refresh, < 10 s), access tokens mapped to the account's default key so plan/credits/metering apply, and the 401 gate on protected tools/call before the transport. Sources: claude.com/docs/connectors/building/{lazy-authentication,authentication}. Built 2026-09-30 (v0.21.0): src/auth/oauth.ts, src/routes/oauth.ts, migration 0013 oauth_grants, connect_account tool, test/oauth.spec.ts; metrics row now carries 'oauth: N connects'. Listing stays auth type none + lazy auth (CLAUDE-DIRECTORY.md step 6).
items.proof: first key connected from claude.ai (token issued via /token with a claude.ai CIMD client); paywall → checkout conversion per client in the Daily numbers row

items.title: uk-insolvency: a Gazette data.json body that arrives empty or shorter than its content-length is retried like a 5xx and, after the retries, keeps the previous snapshot without an error row
items.why: Daily numbers 2026-09-30: `uk-insolvency (thegazette.co.uk page results-page=1: Unexpected end of JSON input after 3 reads (0 bytes, content-length declared))`; 09-28 the same `Unexpected end of JSON input`; 09-27 and 09-29 a 500 (retry shipped 09-29, `gazette-5xx-retry`). Four days without a fresh insolvency snapshot on a live surface. The source (`src/sources/uk-insolvency.ts`) already reads the body up to three times; a zero-byte body with a declared content-length is the origin closing the stream early, so: treat a short body exactly like a 5xx (fair-use pause, one more read), and when every read fails, log `refresh_log` status `skipped` with the message and keep the previous KV snapshot (Blind Mode already serves it) rather than `error`, so the row shows a stale-since date instead of a daily error. Verify the current response shape through the relay first (`GET RANGE=0-4095` of the data.json URL with the corporate notice types).
items.proof: uk-insolvency absent from `refresh errors` for 7 consecutive days; the snapshot's newest notice date within 2 days of today
